notes.title: INFLUXIS Beta 0.1 Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

First, I wanted to thank everyone who has been continuously supporting the game so far, be it by directly helping in its development, making videos, testing it or being active on discord, it really means a lot. Over the past year and a half I have been working on a full rework of the game, and I am excited to announce that INFLUXIS Beta 0.1 will be releasing on January 27th, or shortly after if any delays occur. Here is the list of what to expect from the new update.

World:
- 25 new biomes
- 60 new creatures
- Improved water system
- Improved atmosphere and custom weather system

Gameplay:
- New character model and animations
- New inventory and crafting system
- New building system
- New scan and blueprint system
- New UI system
- New creature AI
- New, controllable EVE droid
- New tools and upgradable equipment
- New vehicles

Others:
- New story and cinematics
- New sound system
- Multiple slots save system
- Improved graphic settings and custom controls

A big thank you to everyone who has supported the game, especially through this long period of silent development, and I hope you enjoy the update :).

notes.title: INFLUXIS – 0.96 – Improvement Update:
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

With the Easter holidays approaching, development on the game will restart, this time, on a smaller update, which should be out on the 16th of April. Without further ado, this is what the 0.96 update will include:
-	World optimization – will do my best to improve game optimization.
-	Bug fixes: no more game breaking bugs and random deaths.
-	Audio System overhaul: heavy work will be put into developing the audio system, from numerous creature sfx, to biome soundtracks and spatial and Ambiental sounds systems.
-	If enough time, some other features might be implemented as well.
Hope everyone is doing ok and see you in April!
Love,

Petru, BaleYc Studios

notes.title: My Ocean Home - Christmas Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

With the winter holidays approaching, I couldn’t imagine letting them pass without a small gift, a big new update. With one month left to go till its release, expect amazing gameplay features, new biomes, and a completely new story amongst many others. So, without further ado, here is what the Ocean is my home - Christmas Update will include:

Gameplay Features:
-	Basic Base Construction – by far the hardest thing to implement, I will do my best to integrate such a system into the game. While not a given in such a short amount of time, there are high chances it will be implemented. The player should be able to construct a modular base, and place objects and furniture inside.
-	New character model and new improved animations.
-	New blueprints and crafting recipes.
-	Vehicles and Oxygen Plant rework.

World Features:
-	Day and Night Cycle – after such a long wait, the game should finally have a day and night cycle, making the world feel way more alive.
-	Weather system – alongside the day and night cycle, a weather system should also be implemented, making the world feel even more dynamic.
-	New Biomes – 5 new biomes to be implemented – The Scarlet Zone, which will replace the Magent Glade and contain – the Scarlet Jungle, the Ruby Caves and the Crimson Beach. The other two biomes will be the Sun Reef Grottos and Sun Bamboo Caverns. There will also be improvements to the Sun Reef and Sun Bamboo Forest.
-	New improved water system and caustics.
-	Music and SFX improvement.

Story Features:
-	New Storyline, with new voice actors and character models
-	New opening Cinematic.
-	New Ship model, with multiple rooms, as well as new Outposts to explore throughout the map.
-	Data Pads to collect all over the map, giving extra information to the player regarding past events.

Other Features:
-	UI Improvements.
-	New Tyler model.
-	Fixing of most bugs reported during the latest testing phase.

While all of these features are not guaranteed to be implemented in this update, I will do my best to implement them all in this short amount  of time. And with that, I wish you all some happy Christmas holidays and hope you will like the Update 😊.

Also, don't forget to join our community at: https://discord.gg/SASN3A2CXh

Love,

Petru, BaleYc Studios

notes.title: Machinery Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Although the release of the Blue New World Part II Update had several long delays, it was finally released on the 7th of September. This being said, I wouldn’t be doing the game justice if I didn’t make at least one more update before taking again a long break from development. This is why I am pleased to announce that a small and quick update is expected for the 15th of September.
The Machinery Update will allow the player to have access to an abandoned vehicle construction yard, where as the name suggests, he will be able to construct 2 vehicles: a boat and a submarine. In order to have access to their construction recipes, the player will first have to find enough blueprints on the map. There is as well a possibility I will add upgrades to the vehicles, although not certain.

Love,

Petru, BaleYc Studios

notes.title: Blue New World - Colossal Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

With the Easter Holidays approaching, so does development on the game restart. But this time, I have truly huge plans for the next update, which will be by far the largest update yet. It will be the first Colossal Update, which is the term I will use for truly game changing updates.
The Blue New World Update, will thus, as the title implies, be a complete remake and rework of the whole world. I am currently not satisfied with how the current world looks and feel like I have gathered enough game design experience during the last couple of months of development to create a much better and immersive map. So, without further ado, this is what this colossal update will include:

Voxel Terrain: By far, the biggest thing will be the transition from a regular plane landscape to a fully volumetric voxelised terrain. This will allow for much more realistic terrain construction, and, most importantly, amazing cave system generation, which I can’t wait to start working on :).

Greater Map size: I have decided that the current map is too small, so if I am starting all from scratch again, might as well go big. I plan to make the map 2.5 times as big as the original, which will most likely be the final size of the map. I will also remove the Ice borders, leaving for an infinite span of water in all directions. This will mean that players will also have access to areas of the map I wouldn’t have started working on yet (which was the purpose of the Ice borders in the first place, to prevent the player from reaching those areas), but I think that the fact that those areas will be empty and quite deep will actually make the player return to the main area, while also increasing the immersion.

Complete and total biome rework: One biome will get a completely new look starting this update: and yes, I am referring to the shallow reef, the starting biome full of corals. From now on, it will be called the Sun Reef. I think that it currently looks way worse than all the rest, and so will need a complete aesthetic reshape. The other biomes: the kelp jungle, crystal caves, and rich plateaus will also be improved, but won’t be completely reshaped.

New biome: There will also be a new biome: the Mangrove Forest. This biome will replace the current Nordic kelp jungle. I won’t spoil it too much, just know that it will be a shallow to medium depth biome and will be awesome!

New biome types – cave biomes: This one is huge. Most of the biomes will also have their own sub-biome in the form of a cave network biome, meaning that most biomes will have cave systems which will look and feel completely different from the surface version of the biome, and will harbour different resources and dangers. I plan to start by making 3 cave biomes in this update (excluding the crystal caves).

Alien Altars: scattered throughout the map, the player will also be able to encounter and interact with diverse alien altars, helping him uncover and advance the story even further.

New creatures and fish: It wouldn’t be appropriate for me to make a complete rework of the landscape and flora without a rework of the fauna, so, while not as big as the previous two, many other small and medium sized creatures will be implemented, and we might even see the appearance of the first big size creature in one of the biomes.

New resources and tools: almost all resources will have a better model, there will be many more resources, and each biome will have more specific resources. Also, new tools will be added, such as the sampler, extractor, and scanner, which will completely change the gameplay of the game.

Collectible Easter Eggs: the first collectible easter eggs will be implemented in specific locations.

Player controls and stats update: While there won’t be huge player control updates (as I plan to completely rework the character in another future update), there will be greatly increased player movement speed, allowing for more efficient map exploration and resource gathering, which is a big thing. The oxygen will also deplete slower, and the oximeter will be analogous to the amount of seconds the player has underwater, at least if the player is above 100 m depth – meaning that 100 O2 will equate to 100 seconds of oxygen left, allowing again, for better time management and decision making.

Left hand controls: It has been brought to my attention that quite a few players will wish to play the game, but because they are left-handed they are unable to do so. Therefore, with this update my priority is also to make the game more accessible to everyone, so left-hand controls will be implemented.

Ocean Lighting and water improvement: The whole atmospherics and water systems will be reworked, which means there will probably be atmospheric fog outside the water, the waterline transition will be very smooth, and the color transition from biome to biome will also be gradual and seamless, and not direct and brutal as it is now. The water will also gradually get darker as the player dives deeper. God rays will be more realistic, and the problem with the screen getting darker when going under the waterline will also be solved.

Player HUD and UI Overhaul: Some new updates to the player HUD and the UI will be made once more.

Sound Overhaul: There will also be an update to the sound effects and the soundtracks. The sound effects will be much more in line with what the player is doing, the underwater sound effects will be much better, and the diving sound effect bug will be solved. Also, many new great soundtracks will be added, further cementing the in-game immersion.

Improved Skybox: some small improvements will be done to the skybox.

Improved Performance: Because I remake the world from scratch, I will also be able to take into consideration certain optimization factors and adjust them, allowing for a much better optimised game.

Various Bug Fixes: some bug fixes such as Steam VR launching upon opening the game, seemingly walking on water, excessive motion blur and chests losing their content will try to be solved.

FPS Settings: I will also add a feature in the settings to disable the fish schools from the world: this is because, while the fish schools are awesome and add life and immersion to the game, they are also very costly in terms of performance, so this setting will help improve performance for those who value a higher frame rate over some beautiful fish (PS: I would never do that I love them fish :)), while also allowing those who have more powerful machines to run the game in its full beauty.

This, as I said, will be the first Colossal Update, bringing the game by itself to the Alpha 0.78 stage (which means I will consider the Alpha stage 78% complete upon release of the update). I also said this will be the first Colossal Update, as I intend to follow this update with a second Colossal Update, which could be even bigger and more important than this one, and which will bring the game to the Alpha 0.95 stage, but won’t spoil anything else about it, just know that it is in the works ;). Such an update requires enormous amounts of work, but I will do my absolute best to finish it and deliver it in time, around the 1st of May.

So strap yourselves, and prepare for a deep dive, hope you will enjoy it.

Love,

Petru, BaleYc Studios

notes.title: What's next ?
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First, I just wanted to say that I hope that everyone enjoys the mistery update. While it wasn't a very big update, it sure added a whole lot of cool features that I hope everyone appreciates (won't tell what those features are you guys have to dive in the game and experience them yourselves ;)).

I also wanted to talk a bit about the future of the game. This will propbably be the last update for a while, and it might be a long while, although it's not sure how the whole situation will evolve. This is because I am starting college again and won't have time to work on it for the next months. The earliest possible update will thus most probably be in april (although there might be some very small bug fix updates along the way), and even that is not guaranteed as development of each update (believe it or not :)) takes a very long time, and I also have to look after myself and live a balanced life, which I hope everyone will understand. This doesn't mean updates will stop, no not at all, but it just means they will be much rarer, but I guess (and hope XD) people might be more excited about them. But don't worry, once I get back to work seriously the next updates will be greater then ever ! This being said, in the meanwhile, try explorig the world of INFLUXIS as much as you can, squeeze as much of the content I put in and advance (and don't forget to share your progress I love seeing how people progress in the game ;) ).

For the next updates, I will consider implementing features (in no particular order) such as:
- Submarine and boat creation and use
- Crafting Overhaul: tons of new ressources, items and maybe blueprints implementation
- Character Overhaul: new model and smoother and better character animations
- Shallow Reef biome complete transformation (as I am not satisfied with how it currently looks)
- Missions and data box expansion
- Alien Structures complete overhaul and addition
- New creatures and fish (some quite large) addition
- Lighting problems fixes
- many bug fixes
- further work on optimization
- Fish and Creatures Overhaul - many current ennemies will have new models
- New biome: Blood forest (deep)
- New biome: Arctic shallows (shallow)
- New biome: Blue Crevasse (deep)
- Story and lore development
- and other cool new features
And please if you have any other suggestions, feel free to put them in the comments, and chances are it will be implemented at some point if it fits the game :).

I plan to implement all of these changes by the end of 2021. I also wanted to talk in this announcement about the total development time of INFLUXIS. In case people didn't notice yet, this is a huge game to develop (especially by a single person working in his free time on it) which I absolutely enjoy working on, but still, it takes a very long time to build. This is why, I cannot say for sure when the 1.0 version will be released. I can say however, that it will be a couple of years (if everything goes right). Also, I plan to divide the development in several phases. First is the Alpha phase of development, in which we are currently. In Alpha, I will be focusing on adding all the basic mechanics of the game, add a fair share of biomes, develop the story partly, and make the game playable, and maybe enjoyable :). The mistery update for example is version Alpha 0.60, meaning I consider the Alpha phase 60% complete in terms of content. I am planning on finishing the Alpha phase towards the end of 2021. Then will come Beta phase which will probably take a year as well if not more. During Beta I will try adding most of the biomes, most of the creatures and pretty much making most of the world. Many other features will be added and I will focus on making the game enjoyable. Finally, with the Beta ending, there will be final versions of the game, again, many updates, leading to the final release. After, the final release I am planning on continuing to support the game by adding new updates a couple of times a year.

I also wanted to say that making the game Early Access was the best thing I could do, as you guys motivate me to keep working on it, so if you like this game and have some spare time, don't foget to share it with your friends, on Steam, Youtube and Reddit, it really does help me alot :). 

See you soon,
Petru, BaleYc Studios
